meta.title: QuietJar pricing - 5% per donation, no monthly fee
meta.description: QuietJar takes 5% of each payment you receive. No monthly fee, no plans, no cap. See exactly what you keep on any amount and payment method.

hero.heading: Of each payment you receive. That is the whole price.
hero.sub: No monthly fee. No setup fee. No plans, no cap. Payment processing is billed at cost, on top, and your supporters never pay a cent more.
trustBar: Processing at cost, never marked up

example.noscriptIntro: A few common amounts, on card and iDEAL, without the calculator:

items.text: The payment happens right where your supporter already is, so far more of them make it all the way to "thank you."

items.lead: Pays the way people already do
items.text: Wallets and local methods like iDEAL are built in, so your supporters use the payment method they already trust.
Once someone has supported you, the button steps back and thanks them instead of asking again.
Add a goal with a progress bar, and leave the upkeep to us.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.text: Stripe pays your balance into your bank account automatically, every day. There is no manual step, and QuietJar charges nothing extra for it.

items.q: Which payment methods can my supporters use?
items.a: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, iDEAL, and SEPA. Your supporters see the method they already use, not an unfamiliar form.
Stripe pays out your balance to your bank account automatically, every day. There is no manual step on your side.

items.q: Does the fee change with volume?
items.a: No. There are no tiers and no minimum. Everyone pays the same 5%, from the first payment onward.

items.q: Who pays the payment processing cost?
items.a: You do, at Stripe's cost, on top of our 5%. Cheaper methods like iDEAL leave you more, and your supporters never see a surcharge.

items.q: Do my supporters need an account?
items.a: No. They pay on your page in a couple of taps, with nothing to sign up for.
Refunds go through Stripe like any other payment. We are finalizing the exact policy before launch - get in touch if you need one sooner.

items.q: How is this different from a hosted donation page with a free tier?
items.a: Most free tiers still send your supporter to someone else's page to pay. The real question is not the fee - it is how many visitors finish the trip after that redirect.

closing.text: A quiet way to accept support, live on your site in minutes.
